g.text: 06 More experiments, less material per experiment

g.text: Traditional: 100k tests, 96 wells, 100 µL/test. Automated: 1m tests, 1,536 wells, 5 µL/test. Base = 100.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; text-anchor: start; fill: #00355F

g.text: Y-axis scales differ. Full plates, no dead volume or control wells; tips fall from 1 to 0.1 per test. ASP excluded.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; text-anchor: start; fill: #00355F

g.text: Source: supplied scenario and analyst calculation. Test definition and plate utilization affect the result.
